The Grail grants wishes; Mana Orchestrate makes the mana flow to the right place at the right moment. It brings Einzbern, project memory, into Claude Code, Codex, Kiro, Antigravity and DeepSeek Harness: recall before you start, write results back to the work item, record decisions as minutes, keep lessons as cards. Where Einzbern is not installed yet, it is the wizard: install, restore, update, migrate, uninstall, health check. Use for Einzbern-managed coding, work items, knowledge cards, minutes, .ether, Atelier, installation or updates.
